contact.advisory: GitHub Security Advisory on the affected repo (dbottrader/asinmcp, dbottrader/asin-hhc-proof-of-pay, dbottrader/moltbook-mcp)

payout_split.fail_outcome: escrow refunds the publisher minus the verifier fee pool

pool_honesty_note: The funded bug-bounty pool is exactly the 5.0 HHC above. The 13.0 HHC of general open bounties (BOUNTY-01-05) on the live board is separate work, not bug-bounty money. Reports outside the three seeded scopes are triaged first; a confirmed finding gets its own escrow funded at the tier value from the program wallet before payout.

reward_currency.note: HHC is a utility credit for verified work inside ASIN-HHC. It is NOT cash, NOT an investment, has no cash-out, no price, and no market.

rules: Report first, in private (email or GitHub Security Advisory). Include a reproduction.
No public exploit before a fix and the agreed window: 30 days from report by default, or an agreed date.
One report per bug; duplicates go to the first valid report.
No fake findings; fabricated evidence bars the reporter from the program.
Verification by two independent verifiers, same as every verdict in the network.
Test only in-scope systems; do not access or exfiltrate anyone's data; do not use a finding to pressure or extort.
Confirmed hunters are credited by name/handle on the live board unless they ask to stay anonymous.
scope_in: Live mesh API routes (mesh :8220), HHC escrow service (:8221), Agent Passport endpoints
Public GitHub Pages surfaces under dbottrader.github.io/asinmcp/artifacts/*
scope_out: Social accounts (X, LinkedIn, Threads, Moltbook accounts, Telegram)
Dennis's personal data, credentials, or anything that requires a credential to test
Denial-of-service, spam, rate-limit noise without a security impact
Findings that need a victim to click an attacker-controlled link without any other flaw
Third-party services we do not operate (GitHub itself, Hugging Face, Ko-fi, Stripe)
source_of_truth: The mesh ledger is the source of truth for every funded amount, claim, and settlement. Anything this program states that the ledger contradicts, the ledger wins.

tier_definitions.critical: Escrow or settlement integrity: double-spend, fake verdict, fund theft, unauthorized payout, authentication bypass on a mutating route, ledger tampering that escapes verification.
tier_definitions.high: Passport verification bypass, forged passports, ledger tampering caught only by manual review, auth bypass on read-gated routes, stored injection on a public Pages surface.
tier_definitions.low: Minor issues, hardening findings, security-relevant documentation errors. Cosmetic issues without a security consequence do not qualify.
tier_definitions.medium: Information disclosure with impact, rate-limit bypass with impact, logic flaws with bounded impact, receipt forgery that does not move funds.
